Supported countries and regions Quickstart Tutorials & best practices 14 must-install skills for TRAE SOLO Top 10 recommended skills for development scenarios How to build a good skill: best practices from creation to iteration Most used MCP servers in TRAE Custom agents ready for one-click import MCP tutorial: Turn Figma designs into front-end code MCP tutorial: Implement automated web testing SOLO SOLO mode overview SOLO Coder SOLO Builder Multitasking Tool panel Figma to code Supabase integration Deployment AI service Payment service Chat Side chat Inline chat Image and voice input Models Agent Agent overview Create and manage agents Auto-run & security Max mode Auto mode Context Basic usages Model Context Protocol (MCP) Overview Add MCP servers MCP server install links Use MCP servers in agents Check MCP server logs Skills Rules Memories Codebase indexing \# symbols Ignore files Browser & Preview Context compaction Slash commands CUE Sandbox Remote development Develop in Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) Remote development using SSH Source control Beta features Agent-powered code review Insights for code refactoring IDE settings IDE settings overview Privacy mode Keyboard shortcuts Extensions Terminal: Mark for AI use Resource Explorer Plans & billing (New) Plans & billing Manage subscriptions On-Demand Usage FAQs (Legacy) Plans & billing Dashboard Troubleshooting General Error codes MCP server-related Python-related Go-related Java-related TypeScript-related C/C++ -related Vue-related Remote SSH-related Performance issues Support Policies Open Source Software Notice About the DeepSeek R1 & V3 model used on Trae Changelog Create and manage agents In TRAE, you can create custom agents and configure prompts, MCP servers, and built-in tools for them. These agents assist you with specific tasks. You can also manage them, including editing, sharing, and deleting.​ Create custom agents​ You can build custom intelligent agents using two methods: intelligent generation and manual creation.​ 1. Enter @ in the AI chat input box, then click the Create Agent button at the bottom of the floating panel.​ - You enter the Create Agent panel.​ - ​ ​​![](data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20version=%271.1%27%20width=%27550%27%20height=%27581.4516129032257%27/%3e)![](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/obj/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/e4349bc88656426190040361160766df~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-quality:q75.image)​ ​ 2. Choose a method to create an agent, including smart generation and manual creation.​ Smart generation (recommended)​ If you choose create agents with smart generation, use the following steps:​ 1. In the top-right corner of the Create Agent panel, click the Smart Generate button.​ 2. In the Smart Generate Agent popup window, describe the agent's functionality, use cases, appropriate timing for use, and other relevant information. It is recommended to provide a comprehensive description so that the generated agent can better meet your requirements.​ - ​ ​​![](data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20version=%271.1%27%20width=%27500%27%20height=%27242.87410926365797%27/%3e)![](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/obj/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/eab3b9774af744e98e7eb33a759400dd~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-quality:q75.image)​ ​ 3. (Optional) Select the Open smart generation by defaultcheckbox..​ - Each time you enter the Create Agent panel, the Smart Generate Agent popup window appears automatically.​ 4. Click the Generate button.​ - The system begins to generate an agent according to your description.​ 5. Modify the parameters of the automatically generated agent as needed.​ - ​ | | | | --- | --- | | Parameter​ | Description​ | | Avatar​ | (Optional) Upload an image as the avatar of the agent.​ | | Name​ | Enter a name for the agent.​ | | Prompt​ | Write a prompt for the agent to standardize and guide the agent in completing tasks. You can specify the agent's persona, tone of response, workflow, timing for using tools, the rules that need to be followed, and more.​ | | Callable by other agents​ | Once enabled, this agent can be called by other agents to accomplish a modular task. When called, the agent has an independent context. Required parameters are as follows:​
- English Identifier: The unique English identifier used when calling this agent, for example, 'project-analyzer'.​
- When to Call: Describe the appropriate scenarios and timing for other agents to call this agent.​
Currently, only SOLO Coder can call custom agents. For more information, refer to "[SOLO Coder](https://docs.trae.ai/ide/solo-coder)".​ | | Tools​ | Select the tools that the agent can use when dealing with your requests, including:​
- MCP servers: After adding an MCP server, the agent can use the tools provided by the MCP server when processing your requests. You can add one or more MCP servers to an agent. For more information about MCP server, refer to "[Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://docs.trae.ai/ide/model-context-protocol)".​
- Built-in tools:​
- Read: Retrieve and view files.​
- Edit: Add, delete, and edit files.​
- Terminal: run commands in the terminal and retrieve the status and results of those commands.​
- Preview: Provide a preview window after generating previewable results.​
- Web search: Search for web content related to user tasks.​ | ​ 6. At the bottom of the panel, click the Create button.​ Manual creation​ To manually create an agent, configure the following parameters in sequence, and then click the Create button at the bottom of the panel to finish creating.​ ​ | | | | --- | --- | | Parameter​ | Description​ | | Avatar​ | (Optional) Upload an image as the avatar of the agent.​ | | Name​ | Enter a name for the agent.​ | | Prompt​ | Write a prompt for the agent to standardize and guide the agent in completing tasks. You can specify the agent's persona, tone of response, workflow, timing for using tools, the rules that need to be followed, and more.​ | | Callable by other agents​ | Once enabled, this agent can be called by other agents to accomplish a modular task. When called, the agent has an independent context. Required parameters are as follows:​
- English Identifier: The unique English identifier used when calling this agent, for example, 'project-nanlyzer'.​
- When to Call: Describe the appropriate scenarios and timing for other agents to call this agent.​
Currently, only SOLO Coder can call custom agents. For more information, refer to "[SOLO Coder](https://docs.trae.ai/ide/solo-coder)".​ | | Tools​ | Select the tools that the agent can use when dealing with your requests, including:​
- MCP servers: After adding an MCP server, the agent can use the tools provided by the MCP server when processing your requests. You can add one or more MCP servers to an agent. For more information about MCP server, refer to "[Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://docs.trae.ai/ide/model-context-protocol)".​
- Built-in tools:​
- Read: Retrieve and view files.​
- Edit: Add, delete, and edit files.​
- Terminal: run commands in the terminal and retrieve the status and results of those commands.​
- Preview: Provide a preview window after generating previewable results.​
- Web search: Search for web content related to user tasks.​ | ​ Use agents​ In the input box, type @ or click @Agent, and then choose from the list of available agents.​ ​ ​​![](data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20version=%271.1%27%20width=%27500%27%20height=%27276.0416666666667%27/%3e)![](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/obj/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/b99ea246fc9540b1bc40d96323ee236b~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-quality:q75.image)​ ​ Edit / share / delete agents​ You can manage custom agents in the following ways:​ - Modify the configurations of your custom agents.​ - Share custom agents directly to X via TRAE, or copy their links to distribute through other channels.​ - Note Before sharing, it's recommended to remove any sensitive information from the prompt and MCP server configuration.​ ​ - Delete custom agents.​ From the custom agents list, click the Settings icon, choose the desired action from the menu, and follow the on-screen instructions.​ ​ ​​![](data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20version=%271.1%27%20width=%27500%27%20height=%27358.2175925925926%27/%3e)![](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/obj/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a17f33b5bb54429ea8a34e160656b856~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-quality:q75.image)​ ​ To share an agent, in addition to using the agent settings menu, you can also enter the agent's editing panel first and then click the Share button next to the agent's name to share it.​ ​ ​​![](data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20version=%271.1%27%20width=%27500%27%20height=%27270.2546296296297%27/%3e)![](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/obj/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/50628442c8a3497bbd75b7e362aa664f~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-quality:q75.image)​ ​ Import agents​ You can import the agents shared by others into TRAE and reuse their configurations.​ 1. Click the link shared by others.​ - ​ ​​![](data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20version=%271.1%27%20width=%27400%27%20height=%27108.31353919239905%27/%3e)![](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/obj/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/12db6926a2004d23a401afd4acfc63ea~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-quality:q75.image)​ ​ 2. Follow the on-screen instructions to open TRAE.​ - TRAE pops up a window displaying the information of the agent that the shared link is for.​ - ​ ​​![](data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20version=%271.1%27%20width=%272788%27%20height=%271374.1330166270784%27/%3e)![](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/a1ea33ceaf904dc3a35c7f28016646f1~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-quality:q75.image)​ ​ 3. Click the Get Now button.​ - TRAE imports this shared agent and directs you to the agent's editing panel.​ ​ More features​ TRAE offers a range of practical features that can work with agents to effectively assist you in developing a project from 0 to 1.​ Use custom models​ TRAE provides a series of outstanding models in the industry. You can easily switch between different models for use. In addition, TRAE supports adding custom models through your own API keys so as to better meet your personalized needs. For more information, refer to "[Models](https://docs.trae.ai/docs/models)".​ Add contexts​ Agents can understand the context of the current project, including code, files, and folders, allowing it to assist you more accurately in fulfilling your development needs. For more information, refer to "[Context](https://docs.trae.ai/docs/context)".​ Input multimodal content​ You can add images in the chat, such as error screenshots, design drafts, reference styles, and more, to express your needs more accurately and efficiently. For more information, refer to "[Multimodal input](https://docs.trae.ai/docs/multimodal-input)".​ Generate and handle code change​ Based on your needs, the agent will automatically generate code changes, including creating new files and editing the code in existing files.​ Note To let you preview code changes, TRAE automatically saves the code changes generated by the AI assistant. If you reject the code changes, they will be deleted from the disk.​ ​ You can accept or reject code changes, including:​ - Handle all code changes in multiple files: Click the Accept All or Reject All buttons in the file list above the input box to bulk accept or reject all code changes in the current project.​ - ​ ​​![](data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20version=%271.1%27%20width=%27800%27%20height=%27177.67220902612826%27/%3e)![](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/obj/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/2498e756eaee428abed8b541d3b7d64d~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-quality:q75.image)​ ​ - Handle all code changes in a file: In the editor, open the file and click the Accept button (shortcut: Command + Enter for macOS; Ctrl + Enter for Windows) or Reject button (shortcut: Command + Backspace for macOS; Ctrl + Backspace for Windows) in the top prompt bar to bulk accept or reject all code changes within the current file. ​ - ​ ​​![](data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20version=%271.1%27%20width=%27500%27%20height=%27159.7222222222222%27/%3e)![](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/obj/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/9b6a837277324dfb9a8e38dcf0f30b61~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-quality:q75.image)​ ​ - Handle a single code change: Click the ^Y button (shortcut: Control+Y for macOS; Alt + Y for Windows) or ^N button (shortcut: Control + N for macOS; Alt + N for Windows) in the upper right corner of a specific code change in the editor to accept or reject that particular change.​ - ​ ​​![](data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20version=%271.1%27%20width=%27500%27%20height=%27197.33796296296296%27/%3e)![](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/obj/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/e60e6f7ebb4e40ee9b77101262beb9b4~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-quality:q75.image)​ ​ Generate and run commands​ Based on your needs, the agent will timely recommend necessary Shell commands for you to run (as shown in the following image). You can choose to run or skip a command, and the agent will proceed with the subsequent tasks based on your actions.​ ​ ​​![](data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20version=%271.1%27%20width=%27500%27%20height=%27241.86390532544377%27/%3e)![](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/obj/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/51d69d57d4484ad092d7ab36c26788bb~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-quality:q75.image)​ ​ After clicking Run, the command will be executed in the terminal of TRAE. Once the command has run, the agent will automatically read and analyze the result. If there are any issues during execution, the agent will analyze the causes and provide suggested solutions.​ ​ ​​![](data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20version=%271.1%27%20width=%27650%27%20height=%27160.99537037037038%27/%3e)![](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/obj/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/8e8d239d044f42e6afe572610f86e846~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-quality:q75.image)​ ​ If the command runs successfully, you can click the Terminal button at the top right of the command card to view the execution logs of that command in the terminal.​ ​ ​​![](data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20version=%271.1%27%20width=%27400%27%20height=%27144.90740740740742%27/%3e)![](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/obj/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/3f677113d8214bbfbd0a5e13577fb394~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-quality:q75.image)​ ​ Preview the outcome​ Once the agent has completed your needs, it will provide a Preview button. Clicking this button will open a Preview window in to showcase the outcome.​ During the preview, if you continue to interact with the agent and modify your needs, the outcome will update in real time within the Preview window.​ Revert to previous versions​ You can revert the project to a version before a certain round of chat.​ Note - Reversions cannot be undone.​ - Only supports reverting a project to a version within the latest 10 rounds of chat.​ ​ 1. Find the target chat bubble.​ 2. At the left, click the Revert button.​ - ​ ​​![](data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20version=%271.1%27%20width=%27450%27%20height=%27109.26892950391644%27/%3e)![](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/obj/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/57a4c40aa33b49ebb43174cdc481bbc1~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-quality:q75.image)​ ​ - A dialog box showing the file(s) that this reversion impacts appears.​ - ​ ​​![](data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20version=%271.1%27%20width=%27500%27%20height=%27233.41232227488152%27/%3e)![](https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/https://p16-arcosite-sg.ibyteimg.com/obj/tos-alisg-i-k9wyc2ijk0-sg/933e3ce753874c69890da7d2ca9e7fca~tplv-k9wyc2ijk0-quality:q75.image)​ ​ 3. Click the name of a file in the list.​ - The file is opened in the editor and the changes going to happen show.​ 4. Confirm the impact this reversion brings.​ 5. If the impact is as expected, click the Confirm button.​ - The agent starts to revert this project.​ Manage chat history​ Click the Show History button at the top right of the chat box to view and manage chat history.​ - To view a specific historical chat, click on the corresponding entry to jump to that part.​ - If you need to delete a historical chat, hover over the desired entry and click the Delete button on the right side. Deleted chats cannot be restored.​ Custom agents ready for one-click import​ TRAE provides a series of example custom agents that can be directly imported and used for different scenarios in project development. ​ These agents can be called individually, or automatically called by SOLO Coder at the corresponding stage of the development process to complete specific tasks. For more information, refer to "[Custom agents ready for one-click import](https://docs.trae.ai/ide/custom-agents-ready-for-one-click-import)".​ Previous Agent overview Next Auto-run & security
